newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-TAUZIAT KNOCKS OUT HABSUDOVA, FACES HINGIS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-TAUZIAT KNOCKS OUT HABSUDOVA, FACES HINGIS.

text.p: Local favourite Nathalie Tauziat of France knocked out sixth seed Karina Habsudova of Slovakia on Thursday to set up a quarter-final clash with top seed Martina Hingis at the Paris Open women's tennis tournament.
Unseeded Tauziat delighted her home fans by scoring a hard-fought, 6-4 7-6 win. She now faces a tough encounter with Hingis, the Australian Open winner, yet to lose a match this season.

Mary Pierce of France, who lost to Hingis in the Australian Open final, had a far more easy passage to the quarter-finals as her opponent, Czech qualifier Adriana Gersi, was ill and failed to turn up for the match.
Pierce now meets Czech Jana Novotna, the second seed, who beat Kristie Boogert of the Netherlands in straight sets, 6-2 6-4.
